articles.title: Psst! Toy Story 5 Has Secret Scenes After the Credits!
articles.summary: Did you know Toy Story 5 hides extra scenes during AND after the credits? You'll see the toys one last time if you stay in your seat. There's even a surprise after all the names roll by.

articles.title: This Astronaut Has One Leg — and He Might Go to Space!
articles.summary: John McFall lost his leg in a motorcycle crash at 19. Now he's a surgeon, a Paralympic medalist, and could be the first disabled astronaut in space! He might fly to a new space station next year.

articles.title: Tick-Tock Goes the Nucleus! The World's First Nuclear Clock Is Here
articles.summary: Scientists built a clock that ticks using the heart of an atom — its nucleus! It's super precise and could help find dark matter or even a fifth force of nature. It ran for 24 hours straight!
